spans.s: यकृत् n. 1. The liver; 2. a disease of the liver.(यकन् is optionally substituted for this word in some of the declensions.)
यकृत्-आत्मिका f. a kind of cockroach.
यकृत्-उदर n. enlargment of the liver.
यकृत्-कोष m. the membrane enveloping the liver.

यक्ष m. 1. A class of demigods, attendant on Kubera and employed in guarding his treasures, यस्यां यक्षाः सितमणिमयान्येत्य हर्म्यस्थलानि Megh.ii.3, Bg.x.23, xi.22; 2. a ghost, an evil spirit; 3. the palace of Indra.
यक्ष-अधिप, -अधिपति m. Kubera, the lord of Yakshas.
यक्ष-अधिप, -अधिपति m. Kubera, the lord of Yakshas.
यक्ष-आवास m. the Indian fig tree.
यक्ष-कर्दम m. an ointment consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk, kakkola and saffron mixed in equal proportions, (कर्पूरागुरुकस्तूरीकल्लोलैर्यक्षकर्दमः Am.ii.6.133).
यक्ष-ग्रह m. the being possessed by an evil spirit.
यक्ष-तरु m. the Indian fig tree.
यक्ष-धूप m. resin, incense.
यक्ष-रस m. a kind of intoxicating drink.
यक्ष-राज्, -राज m. a name of Kubera.
यक्ष-राज्, -राज m. a name of Kubera.
यक्ष-रात्रि f. the festival of Dīpāvalī on the full-moon-day in the month of Kārtīka.
यक्ष-वित्त a. one who stores up wealth but never uses it.
यक्षिणी f. 1. A female Yaksha; 2. a female fiend attendant on Durgā; 3. a fairy.
यक्षी f. A female Yaksha, स्वक्षी यक्षी साप्यदृश्यतामयासीत् D.K.
यक्ष्म m. Pulmonary disease, consumption.
यक्ष्म m. Pulmonary disease, consumption.
यक्ष्म-ग्रह m. an attack of consumption.
यक्ष्म-ग्रह m. an attack of consumption.
यक्ष्म-घ्नी f. a grape.
यक्ष्म-घ्नी f. a grape.
यक्ष्मिन् a. (f. णी) One who suffers from consumption, M.iii.154.
यक्ष्मिन् a. (f. णी) One who suffers from consumption, M.iii.154.
